question: In response to an inquiry about dissolution, what totality is requested to be told to the speaker and into what does it go?
premises: An inquiry is made as to in what something goes to dissolution.
The particle structure marks emphasis on that locus.
The speaker requests that the whole of that matter be told to them.
inference: The request is for a full account of that which goes to dissolution and of the locus in which it goes to dissolution.
uncertainties: Locus and referent not specified in this verse
plain_english: And indeed, into what does it go to dissolution? Tell me all of that.
